question: Which of the following options represents only the units of energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joule, Calorie, Kilowatt hour**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **option that represents only units of energy is Joule, Calorie, Kilowatt hour. **
 
• **Joule (J)** is the standard unit of energy in the International System of Units (SI).
 
• **Calorie (cal)** is a unit of energy commonly used to measure heat energy.
 
• **Kilowatt hour (kWh)** is another common unit of energy used to measure electrical energy consumption.
